Show Deck v0.4.1

Choose the binary whose board name exactly matches your hardware.

ORIGINAL ESP32-2432S028R / ILI9341 (CYD)
------------------------------------------------------------
Update an existing Show Deck (preserves saved configuration):

  python -m esptool --chip esp32 --port COM5 write_flash 0x10000 ShowDeck-v0.4.1-CYD-update.bin

First install or complete reset (destructive to saved configuration):

  python -m esptool --chip esp32 --port COM5 erase_flash
  python -m esptool --chip esp32 --port COM5 write_flash 0x0 ShowDeck-v0.4.1-CYD-factory.bin

ELECROW DIS07050H 5-INCH HMI, HARDWARE V3.0
------------------------------------------------------------
Update an existing Show Deck (preserves saved configuration):

  python -m esptool --chip esp32s3 --port COM5 write_flash 0x10000 ShowDeck-v0.4.1-Elecrow5-V3-update.bin

First install or complete reset (destructive to saved configuration):

  python -m esptool --chip esp32s3 --port COM5 erase_flash
  python -m esptool --chip esp32s3 --port COM5 write_flash 0x0 ShowDeck-v0.4.1-Elecrow5-V3-factory.bin

SETUP AFTER BOOT
------------------------------------------------------------
Wi-Fi: ShowDeck-Setup
Password: tikitime
Address: http://192.168.4.1/

Install esptool with: python -m pip install esptool

Replace COM5 with the device's actual port. On macOS/Linux it will resemble
/dev/cu.usbserial-*, /dev/ttyUSB0, or /dev/ttyACM0.

The Elecrow build is specifically for DIS07050H hardware V3.0. Do not use it on
another CrowPanel revision or the Advanced/P4 model. Confirm the printed model
and revision before flashing.

The Elecrow update image fixes configuration saving on an existing v0.4.0
installation without erasing the deck. Do not run erase_flash when updating.
